title: 第一卷 第19章 小鱼拜师
novel_title: 津门武圣，从苦力开始每日结算
content_zh:
天色很快大亮。

    镇涛堂里酒气还没散，地上的血迹已经被冲刷干净。

    赵海柱坐在那张紫檀木的大椅上，手里捏着一份刚送来的情报，手都在抖。

    “死了？”

    “王震死了？”

    “被陆川......活活摔死的？”

    赵海柱连问了三遍，每问一遍，脸上的肉就抽搐一下。

    站在他面前的张宏，把头埋得极低，声音发颤，“帮主，千真万确。”

    “青帮那边现在乱成一锅粥，连夜把分舵的人都撤回了总坛。”

    “说是......说是怕陆爷杀过去。”

    “啪！”

    赵海柱猛地一巴掌拍在桌子上，震得茶盏乱跳。

    “好！好！好！”

    他仰天大笑，笑声震得屋顶灰尘簌簌落下。

    “我赵海柱在津门憋屈了二十年，被青帮压在头顶上拉屎撒尿，今天总算把这口恶气出了！”

    “陆川......这小子简直是老天爷赏给海河帮的定海神针！”

    “连王震那种老家伙都能摔死，这要是传出去，过江龙陈龙的脸色怕是比吃了苍蝇还精彩！”

    赵海柱笑得满脸通红，眼中精光四射。

    “传令下去，镇涛堂那边缺枪给枪，缺人给人，缺钱给钱！”

    “谁敢动陆川一根汗毛，就是跟我赵海柱过不去！”

    ......

    日上三竿。

    阳光透过回春堂那扇斑驳的木窗，洒在诊桌上。

    空气中弥漫着淡淡的草药香，苦涩中带着一丝回甘。

    陆川坐在旁边的小马扎上，看着老陈头给陆小鱼把脉。

    小鱼今天穿了件碎花布衫，脸色虽然还有些苍白，但眼神里已经有了光彩，不再是那种死气沉沉的模样。

    老陈头三根手指搭在小鱼的手腕上，闭着眼，眉头时而紧锁，时而舒展。

    半晌，他收回手，长出了一口气。

    “瘀血散了不少，气血虽然还虚，但根基稳住了。”

    老陈头睁开眼看向陆川，语气中带着几分惊叹，“陆兄弟，你给小鱼吃的什么灵丹妙药？”

    “这才几天功夫，恢复得比预想中快了一倍不止。”

    陆川没接茬，笑了笑说道，“只要能好，花多少钱都行。”

    “不用花多少钱。”

    老陈头摆摆手，提笔开了个方子，一边写一边漫不经心地说道，“照这个方子抓药，再吃三个月，保准活蹦乱跳。”

    陆川抱拳：“多谢陈老。”

    老陈头放下笔，却没把方子递过来，而是抬起那双浑浊却精明的老眼，直勾勾地盯着陆川。

    “陆兄弟，昨晚津门闹出的动静，不小啊。”

    陆川神色不变：“混混闹事，顺手平了。”

    “平得好。”

    老陈头嘿嘿一笑，身子微微前倾，压低了声音，“听说青帮那个练了四十年铁砂掌的王震，被人当沙袋一样摔死了？”

    陆川没说话，只是静静地看着他。

    “一身蛮力，能生撕虎豹，这叫明劲。”

    老陈头伸出两根手指，在桌上轻轻敲了敲，“明劲易得，暗劲难求。”

    “陆兄弟这一身功夫，怕是不止明劲那么简单吧？”

    陆川心中微动。

    这老头，眼力毒得很。

    “陈老说笑了，我也就力气大点。”

    “力气大也是本事。”

    老陈头忽然收起笑容，神色变得郑重起来。

    “我观察小鱼几天了，这孩子根骨清奇，心思通透，是块学医的好料子。”
content_en:
It gets dark soon.

    The smell of alcohol has not yet dissipated in Zhentao Hall, and the blood stains on the ground have been washed away.

    Zhao Haizhu sat on the big rosewood chair, holding a piece of information that had just been sent to him, his hands shaking.

    "Dead?"

    "Wang Zhen is dead?"

    "Being beaten to death by Lu Chuan...?"

    Zhao Haizhu asked three times in a row. Every time he asked, the flesh on his face twitched.

    Zhang Hong, standing in front of him, buried his head very low and said with a trembling voice, "Gang Leader, it's absolutely true."

    "The Qing Gang is now in a state of chaos. All the people who were assigned to the helm have been withdrawn from the main forum overnight."

    "It's...I'm afraid that Mr. Lu will kill him."

    "Crack!"

    Zhao Haizhu slammed his palm on the table, causing the tea cups to jump wildly.

    "Okay! Okay! Okay!"

    He looked up to the sky and laughed, his laughter causing dust to fall from the roof.

    "I, Zhao Haizhu, have been suffocating in Jinmen for twenty years. I was pressed by the Youth Gang to shit and urinate on my head. Today I finally let go of my bad temper!"

    "Lu Chuan... this kid is simply the sea-fixing needle that God has given to the Haihe Gang!"

    "Even an old guy like Wang Zhen can fall to death. If word spreads about this, Chen Long, the Dragon Crossing the River, will probably look worse than if he ate a fly!"

    Zhao Haizhu laughed so hard that his face turned red and his eyes shone.

    "Give me the order, if Zhentao Hall is short of guns, give them guns, if they're short of men, give them, if they're short of money, give them money!"

    "Whoever dares to touch a hair of Lu Chuan will be in trouble with me, Zhao Haizhu!"

    ...

    Three poles in the sun.

    Sunlight shines on the diagnosis table through the mottled wooden window of Huichun Hall.

    The air is filled with the faint fragrance of herbs, with a hint of sweetness in the bitterness.

    Lu Chuan sat on the pony next to him and watched Old Chentou take Lu Xiaoyu's pulse.

    Xiaoyu was wearing a floral shirt today. Although his face was still a little pale, his eyes were already shining and he no longer looked lifeless.

    Lao Chen put his first three fingers on Xiaoyu's wrist, closed his eyes, and sometimes frowned, sometimes relaxed.

    After a while, he took back his hand and let out a sigh of relief.

    "The blood stasis has dispersed a lot. Although the energy and blood are still weak, the foundation is stable."

    Old Chentou opened his eyes and looked at Lu Chuan, with a hint of amazement in his tone, "Brother Lu, what kind of magic elixir did you give Xiaoyu?"

    "It's only been a few days, and my recovery has been more than twice as fast as expected."

    Lu Chuan didn't answer, smiled and said, "As long as it's good, it doesn't matter how much it costs."

    "It doesn't cost much."

    Old Chen waved his hand, picked up a pen and wrote out a prescription. As he wrote, he said casually, "Follow this prescription and take the medicine for another three months, and I'm sure to be alive and kicking."

    Lu Chuan clasped his fists: "Thank you, Mr. Chen."

    Old Chen put down his pen, but did not hand over the prescription. Instead, he raised his muddy but shrewd old eyes and stared straight at Lu Chuan.

    "Brother Lu, there was quite a commotion in Jinmen last night."

    Lu Chuan's expression remained unchanged: "The gangsters caused trouble and it was settled smoothly."

    "Fine."

    Old Chentou chuckled, leaned forward slightly, and lowered his voice, "I heard that Wang Zhen from the Qing Gang, who had been practicing iron sand palm for forty years, was thrown to death like a sandbag?"

    Lu Chuan didn't speak, just looked at him quietly.

    "A body with brute force that can tear apart tigers and leopards is called Ming Jin."

    Old Chen stretched out two fingers and tapped lightly on the table, "Ming energy is easy to come by, but dark energy is hard to find."

    "Brother Lu's martial arts skills are probably more than just Ming Jin's, right?"

    Lu Chuan's heart moved slightly.

    This old man has a very sharp eye.

    "Old Chen is joking, so I will be stronger."

    "Strength is also a skill."

    Old Chentou suddenly stopped smiling and his expression became serious.

    "I've been observing Xiaoyu for a few days. This kid has excellent bones and a clear mind. He is a good candidate for studying medicine."
